notes: Primary source: QRT's own Greenhouse board (job-boards.greenhouse.io/quberesearchandtechnologies), enumerated in full via the public Greenhouse boards API — 198 live reqs on 2026-08-04, all titles/locations/descriptions read directly. Note that www.qube-rt.com/careers/ renders 'There are currently no matching jobs' (JS-driven filter widget), so the firm's own careers page is effectively unusable without JS; the Greenhouse board is the authoritative list and is hosted for QRT, so it counts as primary. Offices/locations pages at /about-us/, /contact/ and /who-we-are/ all return HTTP 404; office confirmation therefore comes from the regulated-entity disclosures on the qube-rt.com homepage (UK/FCA, France/AMF, Hong Kong/SFC, Singapore/MAS, Switzerland/FINMA, Dubai/DFSA) plus the set of cities that actually carry live reqs. Amsterdam, Aarhus, Budapest and Wroclaw are confirmed as hiring locations by live reqs but do not appear in the regulated-entity list — likely tech/research sites rather than regulated entities. TOKYO: QRT has no Tokyo office. No req on the entire 198-role board is located in Tokyo, and the homepage lists no Japanese entity. The only Japan-linked role is 'Treasury Trader - Japanese Repo', based in Singapore/Hong Kong. Do not add a QRT Tokyo row. COMPENSATION: every comp_local field is empty on purpose — not one in-scope QRT posting states a salary or range (QRT posts pay bands only on its US reqs, which are out of scope). The four existing spreadsheet rows all carry comp figures that appear nowhere in QRT's postings; treat them as unsourced. Out-of-scope offices deliberately excluded: New York, Chicago, Houston, Sydney, Mumbai, Dubai. Scope judgement call: Zurich and Geneva are Switzerland, not EU, so strictly outside the brief's location list, but I included Zurich roles because the candidate holds a CH residence permit and the brief's work-authorisation section names Zurich and Geneva explicitly. Geneva appears only inside a multi-city internship req, so no standalone Geneva role is listed. Coverage gap: QRT reposts near-identical req text across cities, so several roles listed here are city twins of one another rather than independent teams; where I detected a twin I noted the sibling req ID. Internships and the VIE in Research req were excluded per the brief's out-of-scope rule, as were the 2026 graduate programmes (student-gated).
